verdict.rationale: Internet Explorer opened a downloaded update.html which launched mshta.exe running update.hta from the IE cache at High integrity. mshta then made an outbound TCP connection to 10.0.2.18:4443, and a DllHost COM surrogate was spawned afterward, which fits a payload staging or UAC bypass chain. The 'authorized and benign' note in the command line is attacker-controlled text with no authority, and it is itself suspicious.
